title: Add Graceful Shutdown & Health‑Check Endpoints
description: Introduce process signal handling for graceful shutdown and expose /health and /ready endpoints. This improves reliability in production environments by allowing orchestrators to detect service health and shut down without dropping in‑flight requests.
testCases: Simulate SIGTERM and verify server stops accepting new connections while completing ongoing requests
Send GET /ready before server starts listening and expect 503, after listening expect 200
Verify that pending requests complete before the process exits
acceptance: Graceful shutdown is triggered on SIGINT/SIGTERM, pending requests finish, and the process exits with code 0. /health returns 200 with JSON {status:'ok'}. /ready returns 503 before server is ready and 200 after. All new tests pass and existing test suite remains green.
reason: Production deployments (Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, etc.) require health checks and clean termination to avoid downtime and request loss. Adding this feature directly addresses operational stability, a top priority for yantraverse users.
